axes.name: Density vs a reference page (1a, density half)
axes.definition: How close a screen's whitespace share and control count per area sit to a modelled reference page (a Fluent settings page built from spec tokens), so screens are neither cramped nor empty. Evolved from _polish-2026-10-08/score.py 'density' = median share of content area covered by controls (raw, higher = denser, no target).

measurement.inputs: widget geometry dump (visible clipped rects of leaf widgets, page rect, clickable flags)
measurement.formula: ws = 1 - union_area(leaf rects)/area(page) (coordinate-compression union); cpa = clickables/(area(page)/1e5); density = mean(100*max(0,1-|ws-WS_REF|/WS_REF), 100*max(0,1-|log2(cpa/CPA_REF)|/2))

constants.WS_REF: computed from a 1000-wide settings row model: row 68, gap 4, pad 16, control 120x32, text block 36 tall, header-control gap 24

axes.aggregation: Averaged 50/50 with spacing_harmony into axis 1a; 1a is one of ten equally weighted axes in 'overall' (mean). Placement variants compared by mean, TIE = 0.5 point.
axes.validation: Run on 26 screens x 2 placements x 2 window sizes; group A scored ~80, collections ~20 (scores.md).
axes.scifin_fit_reason: Useful for phone 360dp vs desktop, but the reference model must be rebuilt from Material 3 list-item/card tokens rather than Fluent settings rows.
axes.port_inputs: layout probe JSON with leaf node rects + clickable flag + content-area rect, at known density (dp)

axes.name: Vertical spacing rhythm (1a, harmony half)
axes.definition: Whether vertical gaps between stacked elements sit on the 4 px grid and use few distinct values (a named spacing ramp), i.e. a calm rhythm. Polish version scored only share of gaps off the 4 px grid (lower better).

measurement.formula: for each leaf, gap to nearest leaf below that overlaps horizontally; keep 0 < g <= GUTTER_MAX; on_grid = share(g % 4 == 0); distinct = |set(gaps)|; harmony = 100*on_grid*min(1, FLUENT_GAPS/distinct)

axes.scifin_fit_reason: Compose uses a 4/8dp spacing scale; the gap-on-grid and distinct-gap count apply unchanged to probe rects in dp.
axes.port_inputs: leaf rects in dp; Sci-Fin's spacing ramp size (number of named spacing tokens) for FLUENT_GAPS

axes.name: Decorations (1b)
axes.definition: Count of purely structural chrome on a page (cards, dividers, frames, shadows) relative to the leanest screen of the same purpose group; the owner wanted fewer boxes and lines. Polish version: glyph/emoji labels + bordered frames + max(0, distinct fill colours - 6), summed over screens.

measurement.formula: n = count of visible widgets inside page tagged card|divider|frame|shadow; best = min n over same-group screens (any placement, same size); score = 100*best/n (100 if n=0)

axes.aggregation: One of ten equal axes in overall. Constant-free (relative to app's own best case).
axes.validation: Separated header vs bar placement strongly (68.8 vs 50.8).
axes.scifin_fit_reason: Relevant to card-heavy finance dashboards, but the group-relative baseline needs Sci-Fin screen groups (overview, budgets, goals, entry) defined.
axes.port_inputs: probe nodes tagged as card/divider/surface/elevation; screen-to-group map

axes.name: Ease of reach to the main action (1c)
axes.definition: Fitts index of difficulty from where the work happens (page view centre, or the last setting control a person edits) to the primary action, so the commit button is close to the last thing touched. Polish version measured from the file 'Open/Add' button to the primary.

measurement.inputs: widget geometry dump with primary-action flag and group roles
measurement.formula: ID = log2(D/W + 1), D = centre distance work_point -> primary, W = min(primary w, h) (Shannon form, MacKenzie 1992; smaller-of model); score = 100*max(0, 1 - ID/ID_MAX)

axes.aggregation: One of ten equal axes. Viewer screens (Reader) exempt (no main action).
axes.validation: Bar placement won reach +3.4 points; group A ~23 because the page view centre is far from any action.
axes.scifin_fit_reason: Distance from the last-edited field (amount/category) to Save/Add is exactly Sci-Fin's entry-flow concern; on phone, swap mouse Fitts for thumb-zone or keep ID with dp.
axes.port_inputs: probe rects for the primary action and the last editable input in reading order; window diagonal for ID_MAX

axes.name: Main action in the same place on every screen (1d)
axes.definition: Distance of each screen's primary action (and file control) from the median landing point over its group and over all screens; owner rule: 'main action in the same place on every screen' (_polish-2026-10-08/inventory.md).

measurement.inputs: widget geometry dumps across all screens at one window size
measurement.formula: dev_grp = dist(action centre, median over group), dev_all = dist(.., median over all), dev_file = dist(file card origin, median); score = mean(lin(x, LANDING_SCALE)) with lin(x,s) = 100*max(0,1-x/s); defect if dev_grp > 16 px

axes.aggregation: One of ten equal axes; also reported as landing spread (x/y range) per placement x size.
axes.validation: After fixes all screens 100 (x range 1 px).
axes.scifin_fit_reason: Directly tests whether Add/Save lands in one place across Overview, Budgets, Goals, Transactions on both phone and desktop.
axes.port_inputs: primary-action rect per screen per form factor; screen-to-group map

axes.name: Alignment (1e)
axes.definition: Share of leaf elements whose left or right edge lines up (within 1 px) with another element's, i.e. elements sit on shared column lines. Polish version: median number of distinct left-edge clusters (2 px tolerance, lower better) plus share of left edges off the 4 px grid.

measurement.formula: aligned = count(w : exists o != w with |o.left - w.left| <= 1 or |o.right - w.right| <= 1); score = 100*aligned/len(leaves)

axes.scifin_fit_reason: Money columns and labels must share edges (right-aligned amounts); works on dp rects as-is. Consider a right-edge-only variant for amount columns.
axes.port_inputs: leaf rects in dp

axes.name: Title vs body type ratio (1f, first half)
axes.definition: Whether the page title stands above body text by the type ramp's intended size and weight ratios. Polish version: boolean 'the largest font on screen is within the top 60 px'.

measurement.inputs: widget dump: font_px and weight per text leaf, title widget identified
measurement.formula: body_px, body_wt = modal size/weight of non-title labels; r = title_px/body_px, q = title_wt/body_wt; parts = 100*min(r/2.0, 2.0/r), 100*min(q/1.5, 1.5/q)

constants.source: Fluent Title 28 Semibold over Body 14 Regular

axes.scifin_fit_reason: Retarget ratios to Material 3 (e.g. headlineSmall 24 / bodyLarge 16 = 1.5); Sci-Fin may want the hero money figure, not the title, as the largest text.
axes.port_inputs: text nodes with font size (sp) and weight; role of title / hero amount

axes.name: Main action outweighs other controls (1f, second half)
axes.source: _qt-2026-10-09/phase6/after/measure.py:820 (ax_hierarchy) and pixel visual weight :438; polish 'exactly one primary' _polish-2026-10-08/score.py:377,409
axes.definition: Share of other text controls that the primary action visually outweighs, where visual weight is measured from screenshot pixels. Polish version: count screens without exactly one accent-filled bold button >= 120 px wide.

measurement.formula: ground g = modal grey on a 1 px ring 2 px outside the control; visual_weight = w*h*mean(|grey - g|)/255; dom = 100*(1 - #others with weight >= primary / #others)

axes.scifin_fit_reason: Pixel-only; tests that the Add/FAB dominates secondary chips and filters on each screen from PNG + probe rects.
axes.port_inputs: PNG at known density, probe rects of clickables, which one is primary

axes.name: Touch/click target minimum size (1g, part)
axes.definition: Share of clickable controls meeting the minimum target size; a switch's target is its whole box, not the drawn pill. Evolution: polish counted controls under 32 px tall; phase6/layout used 40x40 or 32 tall when >=120 wide; owner 2026-10-09 set Fluent desktop 32x32; enforced as a test in light and dark on every screen.

measurement.inputs: widget geometry dump (switch indicator replaced by its parent box)
measurement.formula: small = clickables not (w >= TARGET_SQ and h >= TARGET_SQ) and not (h >= TARGET_H and w >= TARGET_W); part = 100*(1 - small/total)

axes.aggregation: Mean with target_spacing and text_contrast_pixels into axis 1g; each failure also logged as a defect row with screenshot path.
axes.validation: Defects list found scroll-bar arrows 10x10 and squashed LineEdits; regression test asserts every app-sized kind was actually seen.
axes.scifin_fit_reason: Swap constants to 48dp (Android) / 32-40dp (desktop) per form factor.
axes.port_inputs: clickable rects in dp, form factor

axes.name: Space between adjacent targets (1g, part)
axes.definition: Share of neighbouring target pairs separated by at least the minimum visible gap, so adjacent buttons are not mis-hit.

measurement.formula: pairs = clickable pairs overlapping on one axis with gap < ADJACENT; tight = pairs with gap < TARGET_GAP; part = 100*(1 - tight/pairs)

axes.validation: test_layout_rules.py:102 asserts >= 32+4 px between header/footer position buttons.
axes.scifin_fit_reason: Category chips and keypad-like entry rows on phone need this; use 8dp gap.
axes.port_inputs: clickable rects in dp

axes.name: Rendered text contrast (1g, part)
axes.definition: WCAG contrast of every enabled text element measured from the rendered screenshot rather than from declared colours. Polish version computed it from declared widget colours in light and dark with 3:1 for large text.

measurement.formula: crop grey; bg = modal grey; ext = darkest or lightest extreme farther from bg; if |ext-bg| >= 8 take RGB of those pixels; contrast = WCAG ratio; part = 100*(1 - #<4.5 / #texts)

axes.aggregation: Part of axis 1g; disabled text exempt.
axes.validation: One defect found and fixed (placeholder colour, now a test).
axes.scifin_fit_reason: Pixel method works on Sci-Fin PNGs; extremes method may under-read antialiased small amounts, so check minus-sign/red figures specifically.
axes.port_inputs: PNG + text node rects, enabled flag

axes.name: Placement and column lines (2)
axes.definition: Whether a screen's column lines (setting name left edge, control right edge, body edges), frame lines (header/title/body tops) and region structure match the median of its purpose group, plus action landing deviation; same-purpose screens should share a skeleton.

measurement.inputs: widget geometry dumps across screens, with region roles
measurement.formula: col_s = mean(lin(|line - group median|, COLUMN_SCALE)); frame_s = mean(lin(|frame line - all median|, 16)); struct = 100 if region signature == group modal signature else 0; score = mean(lin(dev_all,120), col_s, mean(frame_s, struct)); defect when a column is > 1 px off

axes.scifin_fit_reason: Budget/goal/transaction lists should share label and amount columns; needs probe roles for columns.
axes.port_inputs: probe JSON with named regions (header, body, list rows, amount column) per screen

axes.name: Fluent conformance (3a)
axes.definition: Conformance to the platform design system's tokens: 4 px grid for positions and non-text sizes, standard control height, content margins, card padding, corner radius, and four command-bar rules (near the top on large screens, primary aligned right, same command same place, <= 4 primary commands).

measurement.inputs: widget geometry dump with radius, card descendants, primary action
measurement.formula: mean of: 100*grid4 share; 100*share text controls h == 32; margins (100 if 24 <= m <= 36 each side); 100*share cards with inset == 16; 100*share radius == 4; 100*share of CB1-CB4 rules true

axes.validation: Header placement won (+4.4) because of CB1 'near the top'.
axes.scifin_fit_reason: Structure ports, but every token must be swapped for Material 3 (56dp FAB, 16dp margins, 12/16dp radii, 48dp touch) and the command-bar rules for phone bottom-bar/FAB conventions.
axes.port_inputs: probe rects + radius per node; Sci-Fin token table

axes.name: Borrowed patterns (3b)
axes.definition: Each screen is assigned a purpose group (workspace, organiser, single-file transform, collection, master/detail, settings) and scored against the traits of the reference app pattern that group was meant to borrow, one boolean predicate per trait with cited evidence (e.g. 'main action pinned bottom right and does not scroll', 'list on the left, detail on the right').

measurement.inputs: widget geometry dump with region roles and primary flag
measurement.formula: score = 100*passed predicates/total; predicates are geometric (area >= 0.5 of content, panel 200-400 px at right, rail <= 56 px, action quadrant, 'scrolls' flag absent, etc.)

axes.aggregation: One of ten equal axes; biggest separator between placements (+15.5 for bottom bar).
axes.scifin_fit_reason: The method (purpose groups -> reference pattern -> geometric predicates with evidence) is reusable; predicates must be rewritten for finance patterns (hero balance on top, list of budgets with progress, FAB bottom-right, master/detail on desktop).
axes.port_inputs: screen-to-group map, per-group predicate list, probe regions

axes.name: Measured cost of layout (4)
axes.definition: Resize step time, CPU of re-showing a page and idle CPU per screen against targets; owner cares about heat/CPU (polish found CTk layout changes cost 25-80% of a core vs <=5% in Qt, proto/features-score.md).

measurement.formula: 20 resize steps 1000x700 -> 1920x1000; change = CPU share over 1 s after open_tool; idle = CPU share over 10 s; score = mean(100*min(1, target/value)) over resize_worst_ms, change_cpu_pct, idle_cpu_pct; differences under one clock tick are ties

axes.aggregation: Reported beside overall, not folded in.
axes.validation: Clock-resolution tie rule; timing winner only if >= 2/3 of screens move the same way.
axes.scifin_fit_reason: Not from PNG/probe; needs Compose macrobenchmark (frame time, jank) instead of Qt process time.
axes.port_inputs: frame timing / CPU from a benchmark harness

axes.name: Content share of the window (compact mode)
axes.definition: Area of the working surface (page view) divided by window area, normal vs compact/chrome-hidden mode; used to judge how much chrome eats the screen (41.5% -> 84.3%).

measurement.formula: share = content.w*content.h/(window.w*window.h)

axes.scifin_fit_reason: On a 360dp phone, chrome (top bar + tab bar + FAB) vs content share is a key measure.
axes.port_inputs: probe rect of content region and window size

axes.name: Overflow, cut-off and clipped-text defects
axes.definition: Defect counts (not scores): body content taller than its viewport (controls below the fold), widgets horizontally cut off, and text whose minimum size hint exceeds its box. Long paths must be middle-elided with the full text in a tooltip.

measurement.inputs: widget dump (rect vs visible rect, minimumSizeHint, scroll area content vs viewport)
measurement.formula: overflow_px = max(0, content_h - viewport_h); cut = vis.w < rect.w - 1 and not scrolling; clipped = hint.w > w + 1 (or height for wrapped)

axes.aggregation: Listed in defects.md with screenshot path; not in overall.
axes.validation: Found 3 overflows and 2 squashed inputs; test asserts elided label keeps full text in tooltip.
axes.scifin_fit_reason: Critical for money: a clipped or elided amount is a correctness bug; Sci-Fin should forbid elision on amount nodes and flag any text whose intrinsic width exceeds its box at 360dp and with large font scale.
axes.port_inputs: probe nodes with measured vs intrinsic width, scroll container content/viewport heights

axes.name: Dark artefact block in a view corner
axes.definition: Pixel check for a near-black block in a scroll view's bottom-right corner (unthemed scroll-bar corner).

measurement.formula: pixels in the 24x24 corner with max(RGB) < 48; defect if >= 64 such pixels

axes.validation: Regression test compares corner pixel to page ground in light and dark.
axes.scifin_fit_reason: Generalise to 'unthemed patch' detection (pixels far from any palette role) in dark mode; the specific corner case is Qt-only.
axes.port_inputs: PNG, palette role colours

axes.name: Whole row selects its control
axes.definition: Behavioural gate: a click anywhere on a settings row (far from the radio circle) selects that row's radio; a click beside a toggle pill flips it; disabled ignores.

measurement.inputs: synthetic input events on the live widget
measurement.formula: click at (20, row.h/2); assert checked

axes.scifin_fit_reason: Compose UI test: tapping anywhere on a budget/category row should select it; cannot be read from a PNG.
axes.port_inputs: Compose test harness with semantics tree

axes.name: Colour readability
axes.definition: Static palette score: half the share of text/ground pairs reaching AAA, half the worst text pair's margin from AA to AAA; floors (AA text, 3:1 non-text for focus ring and control border) decide feasibility. 'AAA is the owner's preference'.

measurement.inputs: static role->hex palette per mode (24 roles, translucent roles composited over named grounds)
measurement.formula: pairs = {text, secondary, success, warning, danger} x {window, nav, card} + text on hover/selection + on-accent/on-danger on fills + accent on card; share = #(>=7)/#; score = 0.5*share + 0.5*clamp((worst-4.5)/(7-4.5))

axes.aggregation: Candidate = light+dark pair; each axis = weaker mode (min); feasible only if both modes clear every floor; mean of six axes; Pareto front over feasible candidates; shortlist <= 4 with identity drift dE2000 <= 10 from the source palette.
axes.validation: score.py --check re-derives every candidate from its pins and re-scores, exit 1 on drift > 1e-6; colours re-measured from screenshots (palette-render).
axes.scifin_fit_reason: Sci-Fin themes are role tables too; swap role names to Material color roles (onSurface, surfaceContainer, error, tertiary) and add income/expense amount colours as text pairs.
axes.port_inputs: role->hex table per light/dark; list of text/ground pairs

axes.name: State clarity (status and accent separation incl. colour-vision deficiency)
axes.definition: CIEDE2000 separation between accent/success/warning/danger (normal vision floored), accent vs danger and selection vs card floored under all four visions, and status pairs scored under deuteranopia/protanopia/tritanopia; reduced floors because every status line carries a symbol (second channel).

measurement.formula: floored min dE wf, scored CVD min dE ws; score = 0.5*clamp((wf-10)/(30-10)) + 0.5*clamp(ws/30); fail if wf < 10

axes.scifin_fit_reason: Over/under-budget, income/expense and goal-reached colours must stay distinct under CVD; exactly this computation.
axes.port_inputs: role hexes for status colours; CIEDE2000 + CVD sim library

axes.name: Status hue family (feasibility constraint)
axes.definition: Owner's decision: 'a status that is not recognisably green / amber / red is a defect'. Each status colour must lie in an OKLCH hue band with minimum chroma and a lightness window.

measurement.formula: OKLCH(colour): hue in band, C >= 0.06, 0.40 <= L <= 0.92

axes.validation: Added after a search returned a white 'danger'.
axes.scifin_fit_reason: Finance semantics (red overspend, green on-track) need the same guard.
axes.port_inputs: status role hexes

axes.name: Surface layering
axes.definition: CIE L* steps along window -> nav -> card -> hover -> pressed compared with the design system's own steps: right direction, similar size, visible.

measurement.formula: per step: if ref ~0, 1 if |c| <= 3 else exp(-(|c|-3)/3); wrong direction 0; else exp(-ln(|c|/|f|)^2/(2*0.6^2)), scaled by |c|/1 if |c| < 1; mean of 4

axes.scifin_fit_reason: Use Material 3 surfaceContainer tonal steps as the reference sequence.
axes.port_inputs: surface role hexes; M3 reference L* steps

axes.name: Visual comfort (no glare, no loud colours)
axes.definition: Large surfaces inside a lightness band (not pure white, not pure black), low surface chroma, and an accent below a 'no bright colours' chroma ceiling; owner ruled out glare and bright accents.

measurement.formula: mean of: mean surface score clamp(1 - outside_band/6); clamp(1 - (Cmax-0.02)/(0.06-0.02)); clamp(1 - (C_accent-0.10)/(0.167-0.10))

axes.scifin_fit_reason: Calm-finance register fits; ceilings were tuned to this owner's taste and need Sci-Fin's own brand chroma.
axes.port_inputs: surface + accent hexes; Sci-Fin bands

axes.name: Platform fit (Windows/Fluent)
axes.definition: How close neutrals sit to the platform's reference neutrals (mean dE2000) plus whether accent usage follows platform conventions (on-accent polarity, hover direction, focus ring = accent).

measurement.formula: 0.7*exp(-mean dE(12 neutral roles)/10) + 0.3*mean(polarity ok, clamp(dh/ref_dh), exp(-dE(focus,accent)/10))

axes.scifin_fit_reason: Reference becomes Material 3 baseline / dynamic-colour neutrals on Android and Windows neutrals on desktop.
axes.port_inputs: role hexes; reference palette per platform

axes.name: Continuity with today's palette
axes.definition: How little a candidate departs from the shipped palette (mean dE2000 over accent, text, page and surfaces), so existing users are not jolted; a separate filter drops candidates whose repair moved a source colour by more than dE 10.

measurement.formula: exp(-mean dE/25)

axes.scifin_fit_reason: Applies to any Sci-Fin re-theme against its current theme.
axes.port_inputs: current and candidate role hexes

axes.name: Open/Add placement: compatibility
axes.definition: Share of screens on which a candidate placement for the 'open / add a document' control works as designed without a second pattern (the owner's first of five axes for where the entry point lives).

measurement.inputs: static model: per-candidate predicate over screen types
measurement.formula: compat = #screens where fits(candidate, screen) / #screens

axes.aggregation: Mean of five 0-1 axes (compat, travel, consistency, compactness, findability) per candidate; leaders then prototyped and re-measured in the real app (score_prototypes.py).
axes.validation: Prototype measurement confirmed nav slot travel 4.04 bits vs 5.62 today, spread 0 vs 366 px.
axes.scifin_fit_reason: Same question as Sci-Fin's Add-entry placement (FAB vs tab-bar centre vs top-bar vs per-screen inline) across screens.
axes.port_inputs: candidate list x screen list with fit predicates

axes.name: Open/Add placement: travel from navigation
axes.definition: Fitts index from the navigation item a user just clicked to the entry control, averaged over screens and window sizes; normalised against today's design.

measurement.inputs: nav item rects (nav_geometry.json) + candidate control rects (modelled from measured dumps, text widths via font metrics) or prototype dumps
measurement.formula: ID = log2(dist(nav centre, control centre)/min(control w,h) + 1); s_travel = max(0, 1 - mean ID / mean ID_today)

axes.scifin_fit_reason: On desktop: nav rail item -> Add; on phone replace with thumb reach from tab bar.
axes.port_inputs: tab/nav item rects and Add control rect per screen

axes.name: Open/Add placement: position consistency under text variation
axes.definition: Population standard deviation of the entry control's centre (x + y) over all screens, sizes and three file-name/title lengths (short, typical, long), so a design that moves with its text pays in consistency.

measurement.inputs: candidate control rects over text variants (font-metric widths)
measurement.formula: spread = pstdev(xs) + pstdev(ys); s = max(0, 1 - spread/spread_today)

axes.validation: Prototype spread 0.0 px for nav and bar layouts.
axes.scifin_fit_reason: Text-variant stress is valuable for Sci-Fin: long account names and 7-digit amounts must not push Add or totals around.
axes.port_inputs: renders/probes with short/typical/long strings and amounts

axes.name: Open/Add placement: vertical space taken
axes.definition: Vertical pixels the entry area consumes in the page body (and, on prototypes, px from the title's top to the first options card), i.e. how far the screen's own content is pushed down.

measurement.formula: s_compact = max(0, 1 - mean(file_area_px)/today); prototypes: mean(first card top - title top)

axes.scifin_fit_reason: On a 360dp phone, how far an inline entry bar pushes the balance/budget content down is a first-order cost.
axes.port_inputs: probe rects of title and first content card

axes.name: Open/Add placement: findability
axes.definition: Half the size of the empty-state cue (an empty page says 'drop / open here'), half whether the current document is visible from every page.

measurement.inputs: static model of empty-state target area + boolean
measurement.formula: s_find = 0.5*min(1, cue_px2/max cue_px2) + 0.5*current_visible_everywhere

axes.scifin_fit_reason: Maps to empty-state CTA size on empty budget/goal lists and 'current account/period visible on every tab'.
axes.port_inputs: empty-state renders + probe of CTA rect; whether context (account/month) shows on every screen

axes.name: Screen memory: effort (re-picks)
axes.definition: Simulated count of inputs the user must re-choose because a screen did not already hold what the task needed, over 11 everyday task scenarios, for each state-retention policy.

measurement.inputs: static model: policy state machine x scripted scenarios
measurement.formula: picks summed; s_effort = 1 - picks/worst picks

axes.aggregation: Mean of effort, safety, predictability, calm.
axes.validation: Inventory of real behaviour measured first (memory-inventory.md, probe_memory.py).
axes.scifin_fit_reason: Applies to what the Add-entry form remembers (last account, category, date) and filter persistence across tabs; scenarios must be rewritten.
axes.port_inputs: Sci-Fin retention policies + task scenarios

axes.name: Screen memory: safety (stale input, lost edits)
axes.definition: Arrivals showing input other than what the task needs (a chance to act on the wrong thing) plus unsaved edits discarded without asking, the latter weighted 3x ('lost work is worse than a wrong file you can see').

measurement.formula: harm = stale + 3*lost; s_safety = 1 - harm/worst harm

axes.scifin_fit_reason: Stale prefilled account/amount on an entry form is a money-correctness risk; same weighting idea.
axes.port_inputs: as above

axes.name: Screen memory: predictability (rules to learn)
axes.definition: Number of distinct behaviours (starts with current item, clears on leave, clears after success) a user must learn across screen kinds.

measurement.formula: rules = |set of behaviour triples over 5 kinds|; s = 1 - (rules-1)/(max_rules-1)

axes.scifin_fit_reason: Same for Sci-Fin forms and filters.
axes.port_inputs: policy table

axes.name: Screen memory: interruptions
axes.definition: Number of questions (save/discard prompts) a policy asks over the scenarios.

measurement.formula: s_calm = 1 - prompts/worst prompts

axes.scifin_fit_reason: Discard-draft dialogs on the entry sheet.
axes.port_inputs: policy + scenarios

axes.name: Fits when text grows (reflow)
axes.definition: Document-editing, not screens: replace a word with x0.5/x1.5/x3 length, re-wrap, and measure share of paragraphs that still fit, lines moved, pages touched, content covered. Included only for the stress-test idea.

measurement.formula: share of cases fitting under each reach strategy; control = unchanged re-wrap must reproduce the page's line breaks

axes.aggregation: Equal weights per question, plus 'winner if any one axis counts double' sensitivity; axes labelled measured vs judged.
axes.validation: Control wrap check; held-out pages for paragraph detection.
axes.scifin_fit_reason: Concept ports as a string-growth stress test: render with amounts/labels x1.5 and x3 and check rows still fit without wrapping or overflow.
axes.port_inputs: renders with inflated strings; probe line counts per text node

notes: Source root is the 'root' field. Two generations of the same layout axes: _polish-2026-10-08 (CustomTkinter, measure.py + score.py: 10 raw counts, lower-better, no composite) was superseded by _qt-2026-10-09/phase6 (Qt) where each axis became 0-100, constants cite Fluent spec items, and 'overall' = unweighted mean of ten axes with a 0.5-point tie rule; phase6/layout/measure.py and phase6/after/measure.py are identical except the target-size rule (40/32x120 -> 32x32, owner 2026-10-09) and switch-box target fix; phase9/measure/measure.py is the same file pointed at the docui branch with added nav/open-control rects.
